title: Experiment Phase 2 - Calculate manual credit or debit note

ancestors.title: Experiment Phase 2 - Manual credit or debit note

storage.value:
User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to calculate credit or debit note through the manual credit or debit note

So that I will have possibility to generate credit or debit note correctly

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. While user created Manual Credit or Debit type of billing run in the system, it means that only one document should be created according to the defined values

  2. When user created Manual Credit or Debit type of billing run in the system, document according to the billing run should be calculated according to the following logic:

    1. On the Summary Data tab should indicate two manually filled columns:

      1. VAT rate

      2. Value

    2. Firstly should indicate if there are different types of VAT rates selected for the billing run.

      1. If there is one type of VAT rate selected in the column, system should sum all the values and display them in the credit or debit note

      2. If there are more than one VAT rates selected in the column, it is mandatory to divide them and sum values accordingly

        1. For example, there are VAT rate 1 and VAT rate 2 are added in the different columns and for the VAT rate 1 there are 3 three columns filled with values: 50, 100 and 200. And for the VAT rate 2 two columns are filled with the values: 150 and 300.

        2. In this case: for the VAT rate 1 there will be summed value: 350 and for the VAT rate 2 there will be summed value: 450

      3. In the document system should display different VAT rates with stages with the same logic as we have in the standard invoice creation:

        1. For example, there are three different VAT rates added in the manual credit or debit note, in the document should display three different stages with the fields:

          1. Stage 1:

            1. VAT rate, % - for the first VAT rate defined percentage value

            2. Amount excluding VAT - summed value of the VAT according to the Summary Data tab

            3. Value of VAT - calculated value of the amount and VAT rate %

          2. Stage 2:

            1. VAT rate, % - for the second VAT rate defined percentage value

            2. Amount excluding VAT - summed value of the VAT according to the Summary Data tab

            3. Value of VAT - calculated value of the amount and VAT rate %

          3. Stage 3:

            1. VAT rate, % - for the third VAT rate defined percentage value

            2. Amount excluding VAT - summed value of the VAT according to the Summary Data tab

            3. Value of VAT - calculated value of the amount and VAT rate %

          4. Total amount excluding VAT - in this field system should set sum of Amount excluding VAT of all stages

          5. Total amount of VAT - in this field system should set sum of Value of VAT of all staged

          6. Total amount including VAT - in this field system should set sum of Total amount excluding VAT and Total amount of VAT

          7. Total amount including VAT in other currency - in this filed system should set value of Total Amount including VAT calculated in another currency, for example, in Euros

      4. All other data defined in the billing run should be set in the document accordingly
